name: vitor-solucoes
description: Practical skills for AI coding agents: business and technical documentation, idea exploration, .NET engineering, AI tooling and agent harness setup, and security investigation.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Documentation plugin — business-facing documentation generated from a source code repository, plus architecture and product design documents (ADR, PRD, TRD), each following a fixed template.

plugins.name: ideation
plugins.description: Ideation plugin — structured exploration of ideas and options before a decision is made, feeding downstream into the docs plugin's ADR/PRD skills once a direction is chosen.

plugins.name: dotnet
plugins.description: Dotnet plugin — practical skills for .NET developers to use with an AI agent, covering ASP.NET Core Minimal API scaffolding, EF Core migration safety and query performance review, observability setup, configuration/dependency auditing, and Clean Architecture auditing plus automated dependency-rule guards.

plugins.name: ai
plugins.description: AI plugin — meta-skills for engineering the AI tooling itself: agent-creator for Claude Code agents/subagents, plus the harness-* skills that prepare a repository for AI coding agents (checks, style, banned APIs, tests, architecture rules, agent guide, permissions, hooks, CI, proof), with .NET and Python stack packs.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security plugin — evidence-led investigation of potentially fraudulent job offers, with passive verification, exposure triage, and offline indicator extraction.

plugins.name: ticket-engineering
plugins.description: Ticket engineering plugin — skills a developer runs from inside a codebase when picking up a support ticket: triage, evidence gathering against the code, type-aware diagnosis, and a requester-facing reply draft. Agnostic to the ticket system and to the stack; read-only, with state kept in the conversation.
